_comment: Community-maintained database of well-known EAX-era games, matched by this script's library scanner and used for the install-time 'Heads up' notes. Contributions welcome via PR — see README.md's 'Contributing to the Known Games Database' section for the rules before adding an entry.

games.name: Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition
games.eax_status_notes: The Enhanced Edition runs on a from-scratch OpenAL engine, built for its native Linux and macOS ports. It never had DirectSound3D EAX to begin with, so DSOAL has nothing to intercept here.
games.notes: If you own the classic build too, it's a separate, independently detectable GOG product. See this file's 'Baldur's Gate: The Original Saga' entry (gog_id 1207658886) instead, which has real DirectSound3D EAX and isn't flagged impossible.

games.eax_status_notes: The Enhanced Edition runs on a from-scratch OpenAL engine, built for its native Linux and macOS ports. It never had DirectSound3D EAX to begin with, so DSOAL has nothing to intercept here.
games.notes: If you own the classic build too, it's a separate, independently detectable GOG product. See this file's 'Baldur's Gate 2 Complete' entry (gog_id 1207658893) instead, which has real DirectSound3D EAX and isn't flagged impossible.

games.name: Baldur's Gate: The Original Saga
games.notes: This is the classic pre-2012 build, sold by GOG as a standalone product distinct from 'Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition'. Not surfaced by GOG's catalog search, but the product page and existing owners' libraries resolve normally. Real DirectSound3D EAX, unlike the Enhanced Edition's OpenAL rewrite.

games.name: Baldur's Gate 2 Complete
games.notes: This is the classic pre-2013 build, sold by GOG as a standalone product distinct from 'Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition'. Not surfaced by GOG's catalog search, but the product page and existing owners' libraries resolve normally. Real DirectSound3D EAX, unlike the Enhanced Edition's OpenAL rewrite. Its EAX 2.0 environmental occlusion historically needed VxD drivers under Windows 9x, per the Vogons Wiki's citation for this title — likely moot under Wine.

games.name: Deus Ex
games.notes: Deus Ex defaults to the Galaxy audio driver, which DSOAL can't add reverb to (open upstream bug: kcat/dsoal#79). If EAX sounds silent, try the community 'ALAudio for Deus Ex' mod instead — a separate, native-OpenAL audio path for this Unreal Engine 1 title, set via AudioDevice=ALAudio.ALAudioSubsystem in DeusEx.ini.

games.name: Thief Gold
games.notes: Thief Gold runs on the Dark Engine. Pairing this with TFix (built on the NewDark engine patch) is worth considering for broader compatibility fixes alongside EAX.

games.name: Thief II: The Metal Age
games.notes: Thief II: The Metal Age runs on the Dark Engine. Pairing this with T2Fix (built on the NewDark engine patch) is worth considering for broader compatibility fixes alongside EAX.

games.name: System Shock 2
games.notes: System Shock 2 ships pre-patched with NewDark, which has its own OpenAL Soft 'Hardware Acceleration' option in the in-game Audio menu — a separate native path from this script's DSOAL install. Worth trying if EAX doesn't sound right. The System Shock 2 Community Patch (SCP) is also worth pairing, though it's a general bugfix/polish patch, not an audio-specific one. Note: System Shock 2's GOG listing is the 25th Anniversary Remaster, a different build, so it's deliberately left unmapped here rather than pointed at the wrong game.

games.name: F.E.A.R.
games.notes: If EAX audio drops out during large firefights, try this script's 'Expand Audio Limits' Advanced Compatibility Tweak (256 simultaneous sources, 48kHz) — that's exactly what it's for. A separate, older report (kcat/dsoal#67) described DSOAL failing to load under Wine for one user, but that's not universal — if EAX already works, you likely don't need any advanced tweaks. Uses EAX Unified (eax.dll) rather than native DirectSound3D EAX — pairs with this script's EAX Unified Advanced Compatibility Tweak.

games.name: Half-Life
games.eax_status_notes: The original release used DirectSound3D, but a 2013 update replaced it with a newer audio engine that dropped EAX entirely.
games.eax_restore_hint: If you still have the original pre-2013 CD/retail release installed outside Steam, its EAX calls are intact. Point this script at that install folder via a manual Wine prefix (not in this library scanner, since it has no Steam/GOG entry) and DSOAL should work normally there. For genuine EAX/A3D-style reverb and HRTF on the current Steam build instead, look into MetaAudio (github.com/LAGonauta/MetaAudio, requires MetaHookSv).

games.name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
games.notes: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas needs its DirectSound CLSIDs registered directly in the Wine registry to unlock EAX. Make sure to opt into this script's Advanced Compatibility Tweaks (COM Registry Injection) during install. Uses EAX Unified (eax.dll) rather than native DirectSound3D EAX — pairs with this script's EAX Unified Advanced Compatibility Tweak.

games.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines
games.notes: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines isn't documented (per PCGamingWiki) as having hardware EAX support — its acclaimed sound design is mostly scripted ambience, not DirectSound3D reverb zones. DSOAL may have little to no audible effect here; that's expected, not a bug. The 'List of games with EAX support' community database corroborates this: it lists a separate, earlier game, Vampire: The Masquerade – Redemption (2000), as EAX 1.0/2.0-capable, but does not list Bloodlines at all.

games.name: Thief: Deadly Shadows
games.notes: Thief: Deadly Shadows runs on a modified Dark Engine build. The unofficial 'Sneaky Upgrade' patch (works with both the Steam and GOG releases) fixes a well-documented multi-core CPU issue and other modern-system quirks — worth pairing alongside EAX, similar to TFix/T2Fix for the earlier Thief games. Uses EAX Unified (eax.dll) rather than native DirectSound3D EAX — pairs with this script's EAX Unified Advanced Compatibility Tweak. EAX isn't on by default: in-game, go to Options, scroll to the bottom, and enable 'Audio Hardware Mixing', 'EAX ADVANCED HD', and 'EAX Multiple Environments' (per Creative's own setup guide for the game).

games.name: Unreal Tournament: Game of the Year Edition
games.notes: The base install only has basic EAX 1.0/A3D support built into its levels. Full EAX 2.0 reverb/occlusion for the original Deathmatch and Capture the Flag maps needs Creative's separate official 'EAX Library Patch' (three files: uteaxsys.zip, then uteaxdm.zip and uteaxctf.zip), historically mirrored at patches-scrolls.com — verify the mirror is still live and the files intact before installing. If you don't own this on Steam, OldUnreal (oldunreal.com) now distributes a free full-game installer with Epic's permission. Their patches add a selectable OpenAL-based 'ALAudio' renderer with its own reverb/EFX presets — this is a separate, modern reimplementation of environmental audio, not the original EAX calls, and picking it bypasses DirectSound3D entirely (nothing for this script's DSOAL to intercept). Select the original DirectSound3D-based audio renderer instead if you want this script's classic EAX restoration to apply.

games.name: Unreal Tournament 2004
games.notes: If EAX seems inactive, check the in-game Audio settings: Audio Mode should be 'H/W 3D + EAX', with Low Sound Detail, System Driver, and Reverse Stereo all unchecked (per Creative's own setup notes for this game). If you don't own this on Steam, OldUnreal (oldunreal.com) now distributes a free full-game installer with Epic's permission. Their patches also add a selectable OpenAL-based 'ALAudio' renderer with its own reverb/EFX presets — a separate, modern reimplementation of environmental audio, not the original EAX calls; picking it bypasses DirectSound3D entirely (nothing for this script's DSOAL to intercept). Flathub's launcher for this game is a separate, actively-changing package, not necessarily the same build.

games.name: DOOM 3
games.notes: GOG sells this bundled with the 2012 remaster, DOOM 3: BFG Edition, but Heroic installs them as two separate library entries with their own install paths — this gog_id matches only the classic build's own entry (confirmed against a real Heroic installed.json: appName 1492054092, install path ending '.../DOOM 3'). BFG Edition installs separately (appName 1135892318, path ending '.../DOOM 3 BFG') and isn't mapped here — it's a different, SDL/OpenAL-based audio path unrelated to this game's original DirectSound3D-era EAX support. EAX support was only added in patch 1.3, so make sure the classic build is patched to at least that version.

games.name: Serious Sam Classic: The First Encounter
Serious Sam Classic: The Second Encounter
Unreal Gold
games.notes: Epic pulled the original Unreal-series titles from Steam's sale (GOG remains the actively available option for new purchases). OldUnreal (oldunreal.com) also distributes a free full-game installer with Epic's permission; its v227 patch adds a selectable OpenAL-based 'ALAudio' renderer with its own reverb/EFX presets — per OldUnreal's own manual this is 'not the old original model, but some replacement for it', not a restoration of the original EAX calls, and picking it bypasses DirectSound3D entirely (nothing for DSOAL to intercept). Select v227's original DirectSound3D-based renderer instead for this script's classic EAX restoration to apply. If hardware 3D audio doesn't seem to engage, check Unreal.ini for UseSpatial=True, UseReverb=True, and Use3dHardware=True under the audio section.
